metadata.description: A marketplace for GRU953-Studio: a Tier-sized team of specialised autonomous AI software developers, led by an AI project lead, that turns a plain-English idea and a short pop-up interview into a working, tested, privately-published app. Now a Universal Agentic Studio supporting Cursor, Windsurf, Devin, and all major 2026 platforms.

plugins.name: gru953-studio
plugins.description: An AI project lead plus a Tier-sized team (Tiny/Standard/Complex) of up to 38 specialised roles that interviews you by pop-up multiple-choice questions (Semi-Structured + Panel + STAR), then researches, designs, plans, codes, reviews, tests and privately publishes a working app to your own GitHub — under your name, as sole author. Built for non-technical users, in plain UK English. Runs natively on Claude Code, Google Antigravity, Cursor, Windsurf, Devin, Aider, OpenHands, and all 2026 agentic platforms.
